long_biography.plain_text:
Puttemans began leading Dyls when the Leuven company was formed in 2005. Working with Dominique Van Etterijk, he built an integrated model that selects sites, designs schemes and constructs projects for direct sale. The group’s work spans homes, apartments, student residences and commercial space, with a recurring focus on redeveloping difficult urban locations.

He serves as a delegated director of Dyls and remains closely involved in shaping individual schemes. He also sat on the boards of development ventures in which Dyls held majority stakes alongside the listed property company Qrf. The structure gave Dyls operational control while sharing development ownership with an institutional partner.
